title: ATB Event v1
description: Canonical ATB event object used for hash computation and verification.
$comment: NDJSON line-length cap: 16,777,216 bytes (16 MiB). Readers MAY reject lines exceeding this limit. See docs/spec-v1.0.md §2.3.

atb.bundle.manifest.description: Reserved system type. Must be the first record in a bundle and uses seq 0.
atb.bundle.manifest.$comment: The manifest data payload has two supported shapes selected by manifest version. v1 (the writer default for maximum compatibility) wraps the manifest fields as a JSON-encoded string in event.data — readers must json-decode data a second time. This double-encoding is historical, not a deliberate design choice; it is preserved so existing bundles re-verify byte-for-byte. v2 stores the manifest as a structured JSON object directly in event.data. Both forms hash with the same RFC 8785 canonicaliser as any other event; the difference is only in what data contains. See docs/spec-v1.0.md §3.1.

oneOf.description: v1 manifest: JSON-encoded string containing manifest fields (version, bundle_id, created_at). Must be JSON-decoded a second time.

atb.bundle.anchor.description: TSA anchor record. Written after a successful RFC 3161 timestamp request. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it anchors, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0. The data payload is written as a JSON string with these fields.

atb.bundle.signature.description: Bundle signature record. Written after signing the pre-sign bundle NDJSON bytes. Reserved system type; appended after the bundle snapshot it signs, so it uses the next normal event sequence rather than seq 0.

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the raw 32-byte bundle hash. Encoding depends on algorithm: raw 64 bytes for ed25519, ASN.1 DER (r,s) for ecdsa-p256.

pubkey.description: Base64-encoded public key. For ed25519, the raw 32-byte key. For ecdsa-p256, either a PKIX DER blob or a 65-byte uncompressed point (0x04 || X || Y).

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm. Absent or empty implies ed25519 for backward compatibility.

key_id.description: Optional backend-scoped key identifier. Empty or absent for implicit local signatures.

backend.description: Optional signing backend label, such as local, https-http, aws-kms, gcp-kms, vault, or local:fallback:<backend>.

signed_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp of the signing operation.

atb.snapshot.description: Named bundle checkpoint appended by atb snapshot. Optional human oversight attribution fields support EU AI Act Article 14 evidence.

actor_id.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: identifier of the human approver or reviewer.

actor_role.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: role of the human approver or reviewer.

oversight_note.description: Optional EU AI Act Article 14 human oversight attribution: human rationale or review note captured with the snapshot.

seq.description: Sequence number of this event within the bundle. 0 is reserved for the bundle manifest record.

prev_hash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash of the previous event, or 64 zeros (genesis sentinel) for the first event.

type.description: Dot-namespaced event type identifier. Reserved system types include atb.bundle.manifest and atb.bundle.anchor.

hash_algo.description: Hash algorithm used to compute this event's hash.

actor_id.description: Optional actor identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

org_id.description: Optional organization identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace identifier for multi-tenant attribution.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp of event creation. When present, included in the canonical hash.

parent_span_id.description: W3C trace context parent span identifier.
